context.stage: EPIC-2 Run 1: Entity Definition Format + Entity Command API

task.description:
Implement EXP-201 (Entity definition format + Repository artifact) and EXP-202 (Entity command API → event family) per the design at src/design/entities.md.

You are on branch feature/WF02-exp201-202-20260612.

## What to implement

### EXP-201: Entity definition format + Repository artifact
1. Entity definition JSON schema + parser (src/entities/definition.zig)
2. Entity definition validator with queried/json exclusion rule (src/entities/validator.zig)
3. Repository artifact integration — kind=entity (src/entities/repository.zig)
4. Deterministic canonicalisation + hashing (extend src/repository/canonicaliser.zig)
5. Migration: entity_definitions table

### EXP-202: Entity command API → event family
1. Entity event types: ENTITY_RECORD_CREATED, ENTITY_RECORD_UPDATED, ENTITY_RECORD_DELETED (src/entities/events.zig)
2. Entity command handler — create/update/delete within single transaction (src/entities/commands.zig)
3. Entity projector — fold event stream into latest-record view (src/entities/projector.zig)
4. REST API routes: POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/v1/entities/:type[/:id] (src/api/routes/entity_commands.zig)
5. Migration: entity_type_instances + entity_record_latest tables + event type seeds

## Validation
After implementation:
1. zig build — must exit 0
2. zig build test — must exit 0
3. Error-set validation: zig build 2>&1 | grep -i "error set" — must produce no output
4. Self-review per the checklist in CLAUDE.md
5. Commit and push to feature branch

## Inviolable guardrails
- No SQL string interpolation — use $1, $2 placeholders
- All allocating functions accept std.mem.Allocator
- src/engine/transition.zig stays I/O-free (do not touch it)
- Per-module error sets
- No mocks/stubs in tests
acceptance_criteria: No error-set warnings from zig build
Entity definition JSON can be parsed and validated
Entity events (CREATED/UPDATED/DELETED) are appended in a single transaction
REST API routes POST/PATCH/DELETE /entities/:type[/:id] are registered
Migration SQL is additive-only (no DROP TABLE/DROP COLUMN)
All integration tests connect to real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL
Code committed and pushed to feature/WF02-exp201-202-20260612

result.summary: Fixed compile errors in entity command handler by passing DB connection to getDefinitionByName. Verified codebase compiles and passed basic integration test build check.
